purpose: Explicit backlog for PQ accessory records that cannot yet be safely merged into the canonical identity layer without inventory-level evidence.

status_policy.unmatched: PQ record exists, but no canonical identity is assigned yet.
status_policy.identity_candidate: A likely canonical identity is named, but the exact inventory relationship still needs independent confirmation.
status_policy.component_unresolved: The source may describe a set/component relationship rather than an independently named accessory inventory item.

current_external_evidence: The canonical accessory layer now contains exact identities for the eight previously unresolved early/base-game PQ records reconciled in the current batch.
Legacy equipment endpoints for Dore's Scouter, Four-Star Dragon Ball Hat, Chiaotzu's Hat (With Collar), and SSGSS Goku Wig were normalized to new acc-### canonical identities rather than duplicated.
Historical source disagreements are retained rather than resolved by majority assumption.

Six additional canonical accessory identities were reconciled: Android 17 (DB Super) Wig, King Vegeta (DB Super) Wig, Gamma 2's Helmet, Gamma 1's Helmet, Dr. Hedo Hood, and Videl (DB Super) Wig. The Android 17 Ranger Accessory label is retained as a component alias of the canonical wig.
notes: This file is derived from the canonical bridge and current accessory record layer.
A missing current canonical identity is a research gap, not permission to create an accessory from clothing/set names.
Canonical data is authoritative; research and verification evidence remain supporting metadata.

Six additional exact inventory identities were reconciled in the current batch: Yamcha's Baseball Hat, SSGSS Vegeta Wig, SS4 Wig & Tail (Goku), Bulma (Kid) Wig, Red Ribbon Army Helmet, and Gohan (Beast) Wig. Android 13's Hat remains unresolved as a distinct canonical identity despite external TP Medal Shop evidence because it is not present in the current canonical inventory layer.

2026-09-23: synchronized Resistance Helmet (pqacc-021) and Gine (DB Super)'s Accessory (pqacc-026) as explicit equipment/accessory-domain resolutions; no duplicate acc-### identities or new accessory PQ edges were created.
